name: Taiwan Benefit Company
summary: Established in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1981, Taiwan Benefit Company operates across Taiwan, Europe, the United States, and Japan, focusing on equipment manufacturing, production system engineering, and agency services. The company supplies a comprehensive range of machinery for the food and beverage industry, including advanced processing facilities and diverse packaging solutions. Its product portfolio features integrated rinser/filler/capper monoblocs, tunnel coolers/warmers, wrapping around packers, palletizers/depalletizers, conveyor systems, bag cutting systems, and various labeling machines (including sleeve labelers). Additionally, they offer specialized equipment such as tea extraction units, Clean-In-Place (CIP) systems, and pasteurization systems. Beyond equipment provision, Taiwan Benefit delivers extensive technical services, encompassing engineering design, installation, equipment supply, and complete turnkey project management. The company also engages in trading chemical process equipment, industrial plants, raw materials, and both solid and liquid food processing and packaging equipment along with their associated raw materials. Clients further benefit from production machinery system test runs and dedicated after-sales technical support.
